responsibility: Declares the interfaces and shared state for translating GIMPLE out of SSA form during expansion. It defines ssaexpand, which holds SSA partitions, TER-forwarded values, partition-to-RTL storage, and special partition bitmaps, plus helpers for retrieving the RTL or defining statement for an SSA name and entry points for PHI expansion and full out-of-SSA rewriting.
same_name_distinction: Defines the shared out-of-SSA interface and data container, especially struct ssaexpand and inline accessors such as get_rtx_for_ssa_name/get_gimple_for_ssa_name. Unlike the .cc file, it does not perform PHI lowering or SSA rewriting itself.
